title: Instrumental Case
intro: The instrumental case answers Кем? Чем? (By whom? With what?). It shows the INSTRUMENT or MEANS of an action, accompaniment (with), and professions after быть/стать. Use it with prepositions с (with), за/под/над/между (behind/under/above/between for location). The endings are distinctive: -ом/-ем for masculine/neuter, -ой/-ей for feminine.
rules: Instrumental answers Кем? Чем? (By whom? With what?) - shows means, instrument, or accompaniment.
Instrumental answers 'with what?' or 'by what means?': пишу ручкой (writing with a pen).
Used with быть in past/future: она была врачом (she was a doctor).
Used with с (with): кофе с молоком (coffee with milk), гулять с другом (walk with friend).
Used after certain prepositions: между (between), над (above), под (under), за (behind).
examples: Я пишу ручкой. (I write with a pen.), instrument
Я иду с другом. (I'm going with a friend.), accompaniment
Он работает врачом. (He works as a doctor.), profession
Кошка под столом. (The cat is under the table.), location

items.prompt: Я пишу _____. (I write with a pen.)
items.explanation: The tool/instrument uses instrumental: ручка → ручкой.

items.prompt: Я иду с _____. (I'm going with a friend.)
Кошка сидит под _____. (The cat is sitting under the table.)
items.promptEnglish: The cat is sitting under the table.
items.explanation: Под (under) for location takes instrumental: стол → столом.

items.prompt: Он работает _____. (He works as a doctor.)
items.explanation: Professions with работать use instrumental: врач → врачом.

items.prompt: Я режу хлеб _____. (I cut bread with a knife.)
items.promptEnglish: I cut bread with a knife.
items.explanation: The tool uses instrumental: нож → ножом.

items.prompt: Она пьёт чай с _____. (She drinks tea with milk.)
Лампа висит над _____. (The lamp hangs above the table.)
items.promptEnglish: The lamp hangs above the table.

items.prompt: Я хочу стать _____. (I want to become a teacher.)
items.promptEnglish: I want to become a teacher.
items.explanation: Стать (become) + profession takes instrumental: учитель → учителем.

items.prompt: Дом находится между _____ и парком. (The house is between the school and park.)
items.promptEnglish: The house is between the school and park.

hints: After была (was), professions and roles use instrumental case. What is the instrumental of студентка?
explanations: Быть (to be) in past/future tense requires instrumental case for professions: студентка (feminine -а) becomes студенткой (-ой ending).

minimalPairs.context: Он работает _____. (He works as a doctor.)

explanations: Feminine -а nouns change to -ой in instrumental: книга → книгой

categorySorting.instruction: Sort prepositions: Instrumental or other case?
